title: Portolan registry coverage
description: The collection coverage files of the Portolan registry. A coverage file lists the bounding box of each collection beneath one registered catalog. The index lists every coverage file. Each document names this schema in `$schema`, so a file read alone still tells its contract version. The schema is open: it accepts fields that it does not define.

$schema.description: The versioned URL of this schema.

generated.description: When the registry wrote the data in this document, RFC 3339.

catalog.description: The coverage of one registered catalog.

id.description: The registry id of the catalog. It matches `portolan_registry:id` on its child link.

collection_count.description: The number of collections beneath the catalog. Collections without a usable bbox count here but have no record in `collections`.

collections.description: One record for each map rectangle. A collection whose bbox crosses the antimeridian has two records with the same id.

id.description: The collection id, or its URL when the collection declares no id.

title.description: The collection title, or its id when the collection declares no title.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in WGS84, rounded to 4 decimal places. West is never greater than east.

index.description: The list of coverage files, one for each registered catalog.

href.description: The URL of the coverage file of the catalog.
